'''Ottegan silk''' was an expensive purple [[Silk/Legends|silk]]. It was used in carpets. A green version of the silk was made and was often used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], such as [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to fashion their [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]].
